scenes.label: Mailchimp starts as a side project at an Atlanta web agency
scenes.say: In two thousand one, Mailchimp began as a side project at an Atlanta web design agency.

scenes.label: Intuit's price for Mailchimp in 2021, with zero venture capital raised
scenes.say: It never raised venture capital. In twenty twenty one, Intuit bought it for twelve billion dollars.

scenes.title: Profit can be your funding.
scenes.say: Profit can be your funding. Follow for more founder stories.
